text:
maria_cs: HelioHealth just sent their vendor security questionnaire — they want our SOC2 report, signed DPA, encryption details, data residency statement, and a pen-test summary. They asked for everything by next Wed. Link to form: https://drive.redwood/helio-q1
ajay_infosec: I can take SOC2 attestation + the pen-test summary. Can you confirm which SOC2 period they expect (last 12 months vs calendar year)? Also are they on hosted?
maria_cs: They wrote 'most recent 12 months' and they're planning hosted. I've pasted their questions in the doc above. They also asked for contact for legal to handle the DPA.
nina_legal: I'll pick up the DPA. If they require exec sign-off, that's fine — just need their legal contact and a preferred signature flow (DocuSign vs emailed PDF). Maria, can you share their vendor contact?
eli_sre: For encryption we can point them to our security docs. Short snippet to paste: `Encryption at rest: AES-256; In transit: TLS 1.2+; Keys managed in customer KMS or Redwood KMS with HSM-backed storage.` Also note our default region residency options: us-west-2, eu-west-1.
ajay_infosec: Pen-test: summary below to attach — `Latest pentest (2025-11): no critical findings; 3 medium findings remediated by 2026-01; scope: hosted inference + control plane.` I'll attach SOC2 Type II attestation PDF and mapping matrix to the ticket.
maria_cs: Perfect, I'll forward their form and our docs. Nina — I'll include the vendor legal contact: legal@heliohealth.com and cc their procurement: procurement@heliohealth.com.
onboarding-bot: Task created: ONB-542 — "HelioHealth security evidence & DPA" assigned to nina_legal, due in 3 days.
nina_legal: Thanks. I received the ticket. I'll prepare the DPA template and aim to get signed within 48 hours; if Helio wants redlines, ask them to send markups to legal@redwood.ai.
maria_cs: Awesome — once signed they'll want a 30-min implementation sync. I'll schedule after signature. Marking as low renewal risk contingent on DPA + SOC2 delivery. :thumbsup:
ajay_infosec: Leaving a note for audit: save copies of all exchanged docs in /shared/vendor-evidence/heliohealth and flag for quarterly review.
